title: Deployment Guide
summary: Deployment guide for configuring, deploying, verifying, updating, and undeploying the Nuvei commercetools connector.
notes: Manifest declared DOC; classification uses manifest override. Document is operational deployment guidance with commands, environment constraints, endpoint verification, DMN setup, and SDK integrity procedures rather than an ADR, PRD, or technical spec.
requirements: Requires a commercetools organization/project and API Client with manage_payments, manage_orders, view_sessions, view_api_clients, manage_checkout_payment_intents, and introspect_oauth_tokens scopes.
Requires a Nuvei sandbox or production account with Merchant ID, Merchant Site ID, Secret Key, and API Base URL.

Required deployment configuration includes CTP_PROJECT_KEY, CTP_AUTH_URL, CTP_API_URL, CTP_SESSION_URL, CTP_JWKS_URL, CTP_JWT_ISSUER, CTP_CHECKOUT_URL, NUVEI_ENV, NUVEI_MERCHANT_ID, NUVEI_MERCHANT_SITE_ID, NUVEI_API_BASE_URL, CTP_CLIENT_ID, CTP_CLIENT_SECRET, and NUVEI_SECRET_KEY.
Connector deployment must provide all required environment variables through Merchant Center or the Connect API.
The DMN webhook URL emitted by postDeploy must be manually configured in the Nuvei dashboard before payment notifications are received.
Deployment verification should cover /health, authenticated /status, test payment authorization, commercetools Payment transaction state, paymentStatus.interfaceCode, and DMN processing logs.
When undeploying, the DMN URL must be manually removed from the Nuvei dashboard to stop webhook delivery.
constraints: Connect runtime deploys enabler as static assets and processor as a service on port 8080.
NUVEI_ENV is constrained to test or production.
NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM defaults to sha256 and documents sha256 as the only supported algorithm.
Status endpoint requires a Bearer JWT and is expected to return status OK with individual checks.
Nuvei SDK is pinned with Subresource Integrity; intentional SDK updates require recomputing SHA-384 SRI and updating NUVEI_SDK_INTEGRITY in enabler/src/dropin/dropin-embedded.ts after review.
Package-manager commands shown use pnpm install and pnpm build.
